description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'CustomerGroup' within the Opencart administrative system, responsible for managing customer group data, including listing, retrieving info, generating JSON files, and clearing them. It interacts with models for tasks, customer groups, stores, languages, and file operations.

classes.name: CustomerGroup
classes.description: Controller class handling customer group data management in Opencart admin panel, including generating task data, listing, info, and clearing operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes customer group related tasks by clearing old data, listing customer groups, and fetching info for each group, returning success status.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates JSON file listing all customer groups across stores and languages, saving to filesystem, and returning success or error message.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Creates detailed JSON file for a specific customer group, including descriptions and custom fields, saving it and returning success or error message.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes generated JSON files for customer groups across all stores and languages, returning confirmation.
